text:
maya chen: Quick follow-up from today's EBR — want to consolidate the health signals and slide handoffs before exec readout next week. I sketched a lightweight agenda: 1) account health snapshot, 2) onboarding progress, 3) renewal risk flags + mitigation, 4) enablement asks, 5) actions. Can folks drop owners below?
samir: I'll take slide 1 (health snapshot) and can add the token-level cost trend. Need last 30 days from billing analytics.
jorge l: I'll own onboarding progress slide. Current state: 6/8 success criteria met, two integrations stuck on webhook cert rotation. ETA for certs: Wed EOD.
alina: Flagging renewal risk — product adoption for two teams is stagnating (usage flat for 3 weeks). I've got qualitative notes from last week's check-in (customer called out missing SSO docs). Recommend we escalate enablement + engineering fix.
katie: I can lead enablement follow-through. I'll draft an SSO quickstart and a live 30-min workshop for next Tue. Can we include a link to a short screencast?
samir: putting a checklist in the slide: metrics (DAU/feature adoption), cost per inference, onboarding milestones, open blockers. For cost chart I need the sample query that triggers high token usage (if anyone has examples).
jorge l: example query from engineering logs: `SELECT * FROM usage_samples WHERE account='acme' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;` — joking, but actual payloads are in the support ticket thread #1234. I'll paste a sanitized snippet after lunch.
maya chen: @alina can you summarize the qualitative renewal concerns in 3 bullets? We want one executive-ready sentence per concern.
alina: sure — 1) SSO friction causing low admin adoption, 2) Latency spikes during batch jobs -> nights, 3) Unclear ROI on dedicated capacity. I'll draft bullets and share by EOD.
katie: workshop invite draft: "Acme enablement: SSO quickstart + live demo" — Tue 11am PT. I'll post invite after I sync with their AM.
sync-bot: Calendar event created: "Acme enablement workshop" Tue 11:00 PT — invite sent to acme-admins@example.com
samir: slide owners so far: health: samir, onboarding: jorge, renewal risks: alina, enablement plan: katie, exec ask slide: maya. Can someone take the exec ask? we need 2 clear asks (budget, dedicated capacity pilot).
maya chen: I'll take exec ask. Draft asks: 1) 3-month Dedicated pilot with X GPUs at committed rate, 2) approval for SSO implementation priority (eng SLA 3 wks).
jorge l: onboarding notes: two customers in onboarding bucket (Team A, Team B). Team A is on track for feature parity, Team B blocked by webhook cert — I can do a quick runbook for cert renewal and hand to support.
alina: for renewal risk scoring, recommend we set Team B as "medium" now, escalate to "high" if cert not rotated in 7 days. Also include NPS comment: "deployment too manual".
samir: minor ask — can we include a tiny table of per-route latency 95th percentile in the health slide? That helps justify the Dedicated pilot.
katie: yep I'll pull the latency table from observability and add a one-slide appendix for ops metrics.
maya chen: deadline to lock slides: Thu 5pm PT. Can everyone drop their final slide PNGs into the shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example/EBR/acme-health-mosaic
jorge l: noted. I'll upload onboarding slide + sanitized payload snippet by Wed noon.
samir: uploading health slide by Thu noon. Need @maya to confirm the exact cost baseline we quote (current committed vs projected).
maya chen: copying finance: will paste baseline numbers in the doc by Wed afternoon.
alina: I'll upload the qualitative bullets + risk scoring matrix by Wed 4pm.
katie: workshop materials (SSO quickstart + screencast) uploading Wed EOD.
sync-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Slides lock" Thu 17:00 PT — 1965080000
maya chen: quick triage — who will present during exec readout? I'd like @maya + @alina to handle asks/risks, @samir to run the health numbers, @jorge to do onboarding callouts. Agree?
samir: good with that.
jorge l: good for me.
alina: good — I'll prep two talking bullets per risk.
katie: I'll attend to handle any enablement questions live.
maya chen: final action items: 1) samir — health slide + cost trend (Thu noon), 2) jorge — onboarding slide + sanitized payload (Wed noon), 3) alina — risk bullets + score (Wed 4pm), 4) katie — enablement collateral + calendar (Wed EOD), 5) maya — exec ask slide + finance baseline (Wed 5pm). Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm.
samir: :thumbsup:
jorge l: :thumbsup:
alina: :thumbsup:
katie: :thumbsup:
maya chen: thanks team — we'll do a short run-through Fri 10am PT. Please add any last-minute notes in the slide doc.
